roots.evidence: Disk II boot firmware loads $0800 and transfers to $0801; captured native wait loop at $08AC.

data.evidence: Disk II ROM compares its sector counter with $0800; boot entry increments this limit by two until it reaches eleven in RAM.

external_targets.50780: Slot-six Disk II ROM $C65C continues sector loading, then returns to $0801.
external_targets.50688: Slot-six Disk II ROM $C600 restarts boot after button/key acknowledgement.
